title: Uniform Product Panel and Tab Layout
description: Standardize every product onto one shell layout: Workbench (Hierarchy default + Catalogue), Details (Inspection default), Settings (Mode default + App + General), and fill every Inspection tree with fully-wired editable input controls bound to the live selection.
summary: Standardized every product onto uniform shell panels: Workbench (Hierarchy default + Catalogue), Details (Inspection default with fully wired editable inputs), Settings (Mode default + App + General). Framework foundation: canonical FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, SettingsHostApi extended with theme/app identity, createFrameworkSettingsPanelTabs split into Mode/App/General tabs, appSettingsBodyKey for product settings in App tab, theme persistence (readStoredUiChromeTheme/writeStoredUiChromeTheme), PlaygroundView settings-kind tab merge. Products updated: puzzle 2d/3d/5d, wires, CAD play, presentation, flow, procedural, DAG, map, shooting, sketchpad (PlatformView), CODA (ProductShell). Tests: puzzle 5d play 15/15, presentation 9/9, flow vitest 32/32, dag 10/10, map 15/15, shooting 8/8.
